The scale-up financial model also requires adaptation for the Philippines' two-cycle-per-year system (vs. Brazil's one), which Paul can approximate by treating each model 'year' as six months, though full refinement requires a paid project engagement. Key open question is bridging the chicken-and-egg dynamic: a signed NEF–AGREA–VMC agreement is targeted by end-2026, concurrent with expanding government funding bids that will be strengthened by a more fleshed-out operating model.

meetings.summary: The team reviewed and aligned on the Meralco volume loss and churn model, anchoring on a max system loss exposure of ~20B pesos/year as a ceiling. Churn modeling uses switching rate scenarios of 2% (current PH rate), 15% (Finland benchmark), and 25% (liberalized EU market), applied to both captive customer churn and outside-franchise capture, with solar/net metering representing ~10% of projected losses. A triangulation approach was agreed for sizing the eligible customer population: use Meralco's industrial/commercial breakdown, estimate average consumption, infer peak load vs. the 100 kW threshold (lowered June 2026), apply eligibility assumptions (~90% industrial, ~30-40% commercial), then apply switching rates. Jamie's working hypothesis is that preventing captive churn is higher ROI than outside-franchise expansion, with an illustrative revenue-at-risk of ~11B pesos ($187M/year) and a defensible BCG fee of ~$3.7M at 2%—all internal analysis for now, no slides until value case is confirmed.

Volume growth will not be projected given flat/declining actual sales, with the distinction drawn between Meralco's sales volume and total franchise consumption (the latter masked by solar and open access). Volume loss modeling will use two levers—solar rooftop adoption (Thailand as high-case proxy) and RES switching (5–30% churn range)—with Stephanie continuing the sizing work. meetings.title: AIP working session — governance, funding models, and secretariat operations

Budget sizing was agreed to be delegated to co-leads (PBSP ~$500K/2 years; DOF and PPP Center parallel envelopes), with the TIERCO deck structured around North Star ambition, operating model governance, and a standing progress page for recurring use.
